summary.text: Angelita Mejia is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 58 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mejia's career experience includes owning Nueva Esperanza LLC, an immigration and naturalization business.
She also worked as a Spanish-speaking liaison for U.S. Rep. Steve Pearce (R).
